meta.title: Pirate mode
meta.description: Enables pirate sidebar and conversation-home marks, an ocean background, and a first-mate persona by default. Locale packs, status phrases and persona text are stored by language id under content/, so languages can be added or removed freely. User logo overrides, custom instructions and music settings remain untouched.

ui.hint: Brand marks, pirate wording, status phrases and persona prompts apply live after saving.
ui.masterHint: Turning off restores native marks and wording and disables the first-mate prompt; if a pirate language is active, it switches back to the fallback language.
ui.brandHint: Toggle replacement for the sidebar mark, conversation-home mark, and wordmark; when enabled, you can import a custom image (SVG, PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 2 MB encoded).
ui.brandInvalid: Only valid SVG, PNG, JPEG, or WebP images under 2 MB encoded are supported.
ui.messagesHint: Pirate vocabulary shown in the DSH interface for this language.
ui.phrasesHint: Pirate one-liners rotated by wait duration on the running-status line, one per line.
ui.invalidThresholds: Thresholds must be positive integers with the second strictly greater than the first.
ui.personaHint: First-mate system prompt injected into the agent. Saves hot-reload immediately; leave blank to skip injection for this language.
ui.langSectionHint: Pick a language to edit below. Switching this selector does not change the active interface language.
ui.noLocalePackForLang: No interface wording pack configured for this language.
ui.noLanguages: No language content is currently enabled.
ui.identitySectionHint: Configure your ship name, first-mate name, and main flag. Leave a name blank to disable it.
ui.shipNameHint: Uses each language's default until customized globally; leave blank to disable. Max 40 characters, single line.
ui.mateNameHint: Blank by default; injected only at the top of the first-mate prompt. Max 40 characters, single line.
ui.shipFlagHint: Replaces the ship's main flag only. PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 2 MB, recommended 2:1.
ui.flagUnavailable: Ocean background is not active; flag storage is unavailable.
ui.flagInvalid: Only PNG, JPEG, or WebP images up to 2 MB are allowed.
ui.invalidIdentityName: Names must be a single line of at most 40 characters.
ui.soundSectionHint: Upload custom sounds up to 2 MB per event (capped at 10s playback). Same-event alerts throttle to 2s and manual aborts stay silent.
ui.moraleSectionHint: Tracked per session in memory with no numeric bar; expressed solely through status-line quips and /rum.
ui.identityPreviewEmpty: No extra ship or mate name added
ui.soundTooLarge: Audio file must be 2 MB or smaller.
ui.soundDecodeFailed: Cannot decode this audio file in the desktop player.
ui.soundUnsupported: Only WAV, MP3, OGG, M4A, FLAC, and WebM files are supported.
ui.soundUploadFailed: Audio upload failed; please try again.
ui.soundUnavailable: Notify-sound plugin unavailable; custom audio disabled.
ui.moraleTextsHint: The /rum command description and status-bar quips for this language, one per line.
